entries.jp: 数日後　三人は\n夜陰に乗じて琵琶湖の\n西側を目指していた
entries.en:
Several days
later, under cover
of night, the
three were
heading for the
western side of
Lake Biwa.

entries.jp:
瓦落多（ガラクタ）拾いの
ついでに桂が突き止めて
きた情報によれば
すでに新選組は町での
巡回突風雷舞を終え
次の町へと移ったという
entries.en:
Katsura learned
while scavenging
junk that the
Shinsengumi had
wrapped up their
touring guerrilla
lives in town and
moved on.

entries.jp:
彦根城より少し離れた
そこで新人の強化合宿を
しつつ　雷舞も開いて
いるという
entries.en:
Some way from
Hikone Castle,
they were holding
a training camp
for new recruits
while putting on
lives there.

entries.jp: 井伊による鳳舞合奏の\n実験拠点があるとすれば\nそこだと三人は睨んだ
entries.en:
If Ii had a testing
ground for
Phoenix Rising,
the three figured,
that was where it
would be.

entries.jp: ……遠いのぉ\nその目的地はまだか？
entries.en: ...Sure is far. Ain't\nwe there yet?

entries.jp: 全くだ\nこんなに遠いとは\n思わなかった
entries.en: No kidding. I\ndidn't think it'd be\nthis far.

entries.jp: 頭ではわかっていましたが\n琵琶湖って大きいですね
entries.en: I knew it in my\nhead, but Lake\nBiwa really is big.

entries.jp: だが　馴れない場所で　\n道に迷ったせいで疲れが\n龍馬たちに押し寄せる
entries.en:
But after getting
lost in unfamiliar
country, Ryoma
and the others
were overcome
with fatigue.

entries.jp: ……ああ\nわしゃもうダメじゃ\nもう歩けん……
entries.en: ...Ugh. I'm done\nfor. Can't walk\nanother step...

entries.jp: 根性が無いぞ\nまだ一昼夜しか\n歩いていない
entries.en: No guts at all.\nWe've only walked\na day and a night.

entries.jp: 晋作……私も辛い\n何より　お腹が空きました
entries.en:
Shinsaku... it's
hard on me too.
More than
anything, I'm
hungry.

entries.jp: 桂さん……すまん
entries.en: Katsura-san...\nsorry.

entries.jp: だから\nわしは言うたんじゃ\n右の道じゃって
entries.en: See, I told ya. I\nsaid it was the\nright-hand road.

entries.jp: オレ様の勘はよく当たる\nこの高杉晋作のやることに\n間違いなどあるはずがない
entries.en:
Yours truly's
hunches are
always on the
mark. Nothing the
great Shinsaku
Takasugi does
could ever be
wrong.

entries.jp: たった今迷った男に\n偉そうにされてものう
entries.en:
Kinda hard to
take that from a
fella who just got
us lost.

entries.jp: ああ　布団で寝たい……\nどこかに宿は\nないでしょうか？
entries.en:
Ah, I want to
sleep in a futon...
Isn't there an inn
somewhere?

entries.jp: こんな山中では\n難しそうだな
entries.en: Doesn't look\nlikely, this deep\nin the mountains.

entries.jp: ああ……\nこんな時に弥太郎が\nおってくれたらのう
entries.en: Ahh... if only\nYataro were here\nat a time like this.

entries.jp: 龍さん\nここにいるぜよ！
entries.en: Ryo-san! I'm right\nhere, I tell ya!

entries.jp: ……なっ\n岩崎が何故ここに
entries.en: ...Wha-- Why is\nIwasaki here?

entries.jp: お呼びとあらば\n即参上！
entries.en: You call, I come\nrunnin'!

entries.jp: 弥太郎　何か食いもんを\nもっとりゃせんか？
entries.en: Yataro, you got\nanything to eat\non ya?

entries.jp: だったらちょうど\nいいものが\n鮒鮨ぜよ
entries.en:
Then I got just
the thing!
Funazushi, I tell
ya!

entries.jp: うっ……匂いが\n強いな
entries.en: Ugh... that's a\nstrong smell.

entries.jp: もぐもぐ……\nでも　案外いけますよ
entries.en: Munch, munch...\nBut it's\nsurprisingly good.

entries.jp: おう　美味いぞ\nがつがつ……
entries.en: Yeah, it's tasty!\nChomp, chomp...

entries.jp: ……そうか……むぐっ\nく　食えなくはないな\nはぐはぐ……
entries.en:
...Is that so...
Mmph. I-I
suppose it's not
inedible... Nom,
nom...

entries.jp: 赤かぶら漬けも\nあるぜよ
entries.en: Got pickled red\nturnips too, I tell\nya!

entries.jp: ああ　ちょうど\n漬け物が欲しかったんだ\n……もぐもぐ
entries.en:
Ah, I was just
wanting some
pickles... Munch,
munch.

entries.jp: しっかし　弥太郎\nなんで　こんなところに\nおるんじゃ？
entries.en: Still, Yataro,\nwhat're you doin'\nway out here?

entries.jp: いえね……彦根で大きな\n雷舞が開催されると聞いて\n……これは儲かる
entries.en:
Well, see... I
heard a big live
was bein' held in
Hikone and
figured, "This'll
be big money..."

entries.jp: と思って来たものの\nてんで商売にならんのよ
entries.en: ...so I came, but\nbusiness has been\ndead, I tell ya.

entries.jp: 大きな雷舞？
entries.en: A big live?

entries.jp: 弥太郎は\n左側に見える\n小高い山を指さした
entries.en: Yataro pointed to\na small hill visible\non the left.

entries.jp: あの山を越えた先で\n行われてるって\n話ぜよ
entries.en: Word is, it's goin'\non just over that\nhill, I tell ya.

entries.jp: もしかして　それが\nわしらの目指してた\n場所じゃないのか？
entries.en: Say, ain't that the\nplace we been\nheadin' for?

entries.jp: そうですね……\nそんな気がします
entries.en: Yes... I have a\nfeeling it might\nbe.

entries.jp: ああ　それは\n止めた方がええ
entries.en: Ah, you'd best not\ngo there.

entries.jp: あの町の人たちは\nみんな魂が抜けたような\nふぬけになってまして
entries.en:
Folks in that town
have all gone
limp, like their
souls got sucked
right out.

entries.jp: 話しかけても\nぶつかっても\nなーんの反応も無し
entries.en:
Talk to 'em, bump
into 'em--no
reaction
whatsoever.

entries.jp: もしや　それは天歌の\n影響か？\nおい　岩崎
entries.en:
Could that be
Heaven's Song's
doing? Hey,
Iwasaki.

entries.jp: その雷舞というのは\n新選組がやっているんじゃ\nないか？
entries.en:
That live--it's the
Shinsengumi
putting it on, isn't
it?

entries.jp: そう！\nその通り！
entries.en: Yep! That's right!

entries.jp: そこへ　案内しろ\n今すぐだ
entries.en: Take us there.\nRight now.

entries.jp: え……構わんけど\nもう新選組はいないぜよ
entries.en:
Huh... I don't
mind, but the
Shinsengumi ain't
there anymore, I
tell ya.

entries.jp: なんじゃと？
entries.en: What's that?

entries.jp: もう次の場所に\n移ったと思う
entries.en: I reckon they\nalready moved on\nto the next place.

entries.jp: じゃ　その場所は\nわかりますか？
entries.en: Then do you\nknow where that\nis?

entries.jp: ああ　皆さんをそこに\nお連れして差し上げたい\nじゃが……もう路銀が
entries.en:
Ah, I'd love to
take y'all there...
but I'm outta
travel money.

entries.jp: ああ……路銀さえ有れば\n案内できると\n思うんじゃが……
entries.en:
Ahh... if only I
had travel money,
I reckon I could
show you the
way...

entries.jp: ……晋作
entries.en: ...Shinsaku.

entries.jp: あ～　その売れ残りの\n背負ってる奴\n丸ごと買ってやるぞ
entries.en:
Ahh, fine! I'll buy
those unsold
goods on your
back. The whole
lot.

entries.jp: やった！\nさすが龍さんの\n友達じゃ！
entries.en: Yahoo! Just what\nI'd expect from\nRyo-san's pal!

entries.jp: ああ　その代わり\nちゃんと案内しろよ
entries.en:
Yeah, but in
exchange, you'd
better guide us
properly.

entries.jp: もちろんぜよ！
entries.en: You bet, I tell ya!

entries.jp: おい　ここは\n元の町じゃねえか
entries.en: Hey, this is the\ntown we started\nfrom!

entries.jp: あれ？　それは\n偶然じゃなあ～
entries.en: Huh? Well, what a\ncoincidence~

entries.jp: 案内なんて必要ねぇ！
entries.en: We didn't need a\nguide for this!

entries.jp: ここが彦根一の\n問屋街なんじゃ
entries.en: This here's the\nbiggest wholesale\ndistrict in Hikone.

entries.jp:
特に　あそこの店は
珍しい玩具（オモチャ）や
瓦落多（ガラクタ）
売ってる有名なとこぜよ
entries.en:
That shop over
there's famous
for sellin' rare
toys and junk, I
tell ya.

entries.jp: ……瓦落多？\nじゃ桂さんも　あの店を\nのぞいたのか？
entries.en:
...Junk? So
Katsura-san, you
checked out that
shop too?

entries.jp: うん……\nまあ……ね
entries.en: Yes... well... sort\nof.

entries.jp: しっかし人は一杯じゃが\n静かなんは何でかの？
entries.en: Still, there's a big\ncrowd, so how\ncome it's so quiet?

entries.jp: それに\n通るヤツ通るヤツ\nにやにやしとるし
entries.en: And every last\nfella walkin' by is\ngrinnin'.

entries.jp: どいつもこいつも薄気味\n悪いほどの笑顔だな……
entries.en: Every one of\nthem is smiling so\nmuch it's creepy...

entries.jp: おかげで喧嘩もなけりゃ\n罪を犯す人もいねえって\n喜ぶ奴もいるようじゃけど
entries.en:
Thanks to that,
there ain't no
fights and nobody
commits crimes,
so some folks
seem happy about
it, but...

entries.jp: それも　いいのか\n悪いのか\n……これ　貰うよ
entries.en: Whether that's\ngood or bad... I'll\ntake this.

entries.jp: 弥太郎は向かいから\n歩いてきた男の桶から\n羊羹を二つ取る
entries.en:
Yataro took two
bars of yokan
from the tub of a
man walking
toward them.

entries.jp: お　おい\n何をするんじゃ
entries.en: H-hey! What're\nyou doin'!?

entries.jp:
青くなる龍馬と裏腹に
弥太郎に取られた男は
一瞬　よろけるが
何事もなかったかのように
また歩き出した
entries.en:
While Ryoma
went pale, the
man Yataro took
from staggered
for an instant,
then walked on as
if nothing had
happened.

entries.jp: ほい\n羊羹代じゃ
entries.en: Here. For the\nyokan.

entries.jp: すれ違い様に袖の中に\n銭をすり込ませる弥太郎
entries.en:
As they passed,
Yataro slipped
some coins into
the man's sleeve.

entries.jp:
羊羹売りは　まるで
桶の物を取られたこと
など無かったかのように
また笑顔になって
角を曲がっていった
entries.en:
The yokan seller
smiled again, as
if nothing had
ever been taken
from his tub, and
turned the
corner.

entries.jp: 今のは……\nなんじゃ……？
entries.en: What... was that...?

entries.jp:
よろけるっちゅうのは
反応があるってこと
なんで　今のはまだ
いい方ぜよ
entries.en:
If he staggers,
that means he's
still reactin', so
that one's one of
the better ones.

entries.jp: 蹴飛ばしても　痛い顔も\nしない奴もおりますんで\n……ほい　龍さんもどうぞ
entries.en:
Some of 'em don't
even flinch when
you kick 'em...
Here, Ryo-san,
have some.

entries.jp: お　おう……\n後で食うぜよ
entries.en: O-okay... I'll eat it\nlater.

entries.jp: 体は生きていても　心は\n死んだように眠っている\nまるで人形のようだね
entries.en:
Their bodies are
alive, but their
hearts sleep as if
dead. Just like
dolls.

entries.jp: 何も感じず　疑問さえも\n持たず……
entries.en: Feeling nothing,\nnot even\nquestioning...

entries.jp: 農民は農民　町人は町人\nそれぞれの\n役割を演じているよ
entries.en:
Farmers as
farmers,
townsfolk as
townsfolk--each
one playing their
role.

entries.jp: 何も思わない\n何も感じない\nだから争いも起こらない
entries.en:
No thoughts. No
feelings. So no
conflict ever
arises.

entries.jp: ……バカらしい\nこれが幸せな世か？\n泰平っていえるのか？
entries.en:
...What a joke. Is
this a happy
world? Can you
call this peace?

entries.jp: どう思うよ　龍馬？
entries.en: What do you\nthink, Ryoma?

entries.jp: 怒りを爆発させる
entries.en: Explode in anger

entries.jp: 高杉を抱きしめる
entries.en: Hug Takasugi

entries.jp: 桂を慰める
entries.en: Comfort Katsura

entries.jp: こんなの地獄ぜよ！\n空っぽの笑顔に何がある？
entries.en:
This is hell, I tell
ya! What's an
empty smile
worth?

entries.jp: 腹の底から笑えて\n初めて幸せって\n言えるんじゃ
entries.en:
Only when you
can laugh from
the bottom of
your gut can you
call it happiness!

entries.jp: さすが\nわしらの龍さん\nかっこええわ……
entries.en: That's our\nRyo-san! So cool...

entries.jp: ……ぎゅっ
entries.en: ...*Squeeze*

entries.jp: ……おい\n何の冗談だ？
entries.en: ...Hey. What kind\nof joke is this?

entries.jp: いや　なんかのう\n想像したら　怖くなって\nしもうて……
entries.en: Well, y'see... I\npictured it and\ngot all scared...

entries.jp: だからって\nオレに抱きつくな\n寒気がしたわ！
entries.en: That's no reason\nto hug me! It gave\nme chills!

entries.jp: お登勢さんとお発勢さんは\n喜びそうな光景ですけどね
entries.en:
Otose-san and
Ohase-san would
love this sight,
though.

entries.jp: よしよし……
entries.en: There, there...

entries.jp: 龍馬は桂の頭を\nそっと撫でた
entries.en: Ryoma gently\npatted Katsura's\nhead.

entries.jp: ……え？\nあの
entries.en: ...Huh? Um...

entries.jp: センセーあんた\n今にも泣きそうな\n顔しとったぞ
entries.en: Sensei, you\nlooked like you\nwere about to cry.

entries.jp: 私は別に……
entries.en: I'm not\nparticularly...

entries.jp: 無理せんでもええ\nここについてから\n辛そうじゃった
entries.en:
No need to push
yourself. You've
looked miserable
ever since we got
here.

entries.jp: なあ　桂さんが\n瓦落多を見に来た時も\nこんなだったのか？
entries.en:
Say, Katsura-san,
was it like this
when you came to
look at junk, too?

entries.jp: ……ここまででは\nなかったけどね
entries.en: ...It wasn't this\nbad, though.

entries.jp: 知っていたのか？
entries.en: You knew?

entries.jp: だったらなんで\nそれをオレたちに\n言わなかったんだ
entries.en: Then why didn't\nyou tell us?

entries.jp: 晋作は倒れていたし\n心配かけたくないと\n思って……
entries.en:
You had
collapsed,
Shinsaku, and I
didn't want to
worry you...

entries.jp: ……ちっ\nまあいい
entries.en: ...Tch. Fine.

entries.jp: ……岩崎\n町の様子は十分に\n見させて貰った
entries.en: ...Iwasaki. I've\nseen enough of\nthe town.

entries.jp: そろそろ\n新選組が雷舞をしている\n場所に案内しろ
entries.en:
Now take us to
where the
Shinsengumi are
holding their live.

entries.jp: こっちぜよ
entries.en: This way, I tell\nya.

entries.jp: うっ……ここまで\n聞こえてくる\nなんて　すごい音……
entries.en:
Ugh... What an
incredible sound,
to carry all the
way out here...

entries.jp: こ……\nこりゃあ……
entries.en: Wh... what in the...

entries.jp:
大きな音の流れる
寺の中には
恍惚とした表情で
踊り狂う無数の人々
entries.en:
Inside the temple,
where loud music
flowed, countless
people danced
wildly with
enraptured faces.

entries.jp:
その顔は青白く
頬はやせこけ
目は大きく
落ちくぼんでいる
entries.en:
Their faces were
pale, their cheeks
hollow, their eyes
wide and sunken.

entries.jp:
人影でよく見えないが
満面の笑みを浮かべた
まま床に倒れ臥し
動かない者も何人か
いるようだ
entries.en:
It was hard to see
past the crowd,
but several
seemed to have
collapsed to the
floor, still
beaming, and lay
motionless.

entries.jp: おい\n大丈夫か？
entries.en: Hey! You all\nright?

entries.jp: 龍馬がかけより\n助け起こすと\nかすかに目を開ける
entries.en:
When Ryoma ran
over and helped
him up, the man
faintly opened his
eyes.

entries.jp: 生きてはいるようですね\n早く　連れだした方がいい
entries.en:
He seems to be
alive. We'd better
get him out of
here quickly.

entries.jp: ……なっ
みんな　天歌に\n取り憑かれとるぜよ
entries.en:
Everybody's
possessed by
Heaven's Song, I
tell ya.

entries.jp: 天歌……\nなんちゅう\n恐ろしい歌じゃ
entries.en: Heaven's Song...\nWhat a terrifyin'\nsong...

entries.jp: 龍さん\nわしはそろそろ\n行くわ
entries.en: Ryo-san, I'll be\nheadin' off now.

entries.jp: それじゃあな
entries.en: See ya.

entries.jp: どんどん人が\n集まってきているね
entries.en: More and more\npeople are\ngathering.

entries.jp: 泰平化がつづけば\n町にいる者たち　すべて\nこうなっちまう……
entries.en:
If the pacification
keeps up,
everyone in town
is going to end up
like this...

entries.jp: そして　次は……
entries.en: And next...

entries.jp:
さすがの高杉も
その先は言う事が
出来ず　暗い顔で
口ごもる
entries.en:
Even Takasugi
couldn't bring
himself to say
what came next,
and fell silent
with a dark look.

entries.jp: なあ\nセンセー……
entries.en: Say... Sensei...

entries.jp: 井伊は……\n井伊っちゅう男は\n何がしたいんじゃ？
entries.en: Ii... That Ii fella...\nWhat's he tryin' to\ndo?

entries.jp: こんなことをして\n何を望んどるんじゃ
entries.en: What's he hopin'\nto get outta doin'\nthis?

entries.jp: 残念だけど龍馬くん\nこれはまだ　実験なんです
entries.en:
I'm sorry to say,
Ryoma-kun, this
is still just an
experiment.
An ex...\nperiment...?

entries.jp: 天歌　そして\n鳳舞合奏
entries.en: Heaven's Song,\nand Phoenix\nRising.

entries.jp: どちらかだけでも\n恐ろしいのに……
entries.en: Either one alone\nis frightening\nenough...

entries.jp: それにくわえて\nもっと大きな何かを\nしようとしているんです
entries.en:
On top of that,
he's trying to do
something even
bigger.

entries.jp: 桂の顔が恐怖に青ざめ\n体が小刻みに震える
entries.en:
Katsura's face
went pale with
fear, and his body
trembled.

entries.jp: やはり無理ですよ\nそんなのに私達が\n対抗出来るわけがない
entries.en:
It's impossible
after all. There's
no way we can
stand against
something like
that.

entries.jp: 桂さん　何を……\n松陰先生の教えを\n忘れたのか
entries.en:
Katsura-san, what
are you... Have
you forgotten
Shoin-sensei's
teachings?

entries.jp: 忘れたことなどありません\nですが　私にはわかります
entries.en: I've never\nforgotten them.\nBut I understand.

entries.jp: 私には　龍馬くんや\n晋作ほどの情熱や\n熱い才能なんてない
entries.en:
I don't have
passion or
burning talent
like Ryoma-kun
and Shinsaku do.

entries.jp: だから……相手の強さが\n恐ろしさがわかるんです
entries.en:
That's why... I can
tell how strong,
how frightening
our opponent is.

entries.jp: \fnt1桂さん\n歯ぁくいしばれ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Katsura-san, grit\nyour teeth!\fnt0

entries.jp: 高杉の右手が\n桂の頬を殴る
entries.en: Takasugi's right\nfist struck\nKatsura's cheek.

entries.jp: ……ぐっ
entries.en: ...Ngh!

entries.jp: どうだ\n正気に戻ったか　桂さん
entries.en: Well? Come to\nyour senses,\nKatsura-san?

entries.jp: そんな弱気になるなんて\n天歌にやられたんだ
entries.en:
Losing your nerve
like that--
Heaven's Song got
to you.

entries.jp: 違う\n私は正気です
entries.en: No. I'm perfectly\nsane.

entries.jp: いいや　オレの友にして\n松陰先生の一番弟子\n桂小五郎がそんな言葉……
entries.en:
No way. My
friend,
Shoin-sensei's top
disciple, Kogoro
Katsura, would
never say...

entries.jp: 吐く……\nわけが……うっ
entries.en: ...something like...\nthat... Ugh...

entries.jp: 高杉の体が\nぐらりと揺れる
entries.en: Takasugi's body\nswayed.

entries.jp: 晋作
entries.en: Shinsaku!

entries.jp: 大丈夫だ……\nなんでも……\nな……い……
entries.en: I'm fine... it's...\nnoth... ing...

entries.jp: おっと……
entries.en: Whoa there...

entries.jp: 後ろにいた龍馬が\n咄嗟に高杉を支える
entries.en:
Ryoma, standing
behind him,
caught Takasugi
just in time.

entries.jp: シンディ……ん～ん～\nこらぁ　気ぃ失ってるぜよ
entries.en: Shindy... Hmm,\nhmm... Well, he's\nout cold, I tell ya.

entries.jp: そんな……嘘……\n晋作……晋作
entries.en: No... This can't\nbe... Shinsaku...\nShinsaku!

entries.jp: センセー　シンディは\nわしが担ぐ\n一度　宿に戻るぜよ
entries.en:
Sensei, I'll carry
Shindy. Let's head
back to the inn
for now.

entries.jp: しかし……一体\nどういうことじゃ
entries.en: But... what in the\nworld's goin' on?

entries.jp: 彦根に来て\nこれで二度　いや三度目か
entries.en:
That's twice since
we got to
Hikone--no, three
times.

entries.jp: ……鳳舞の影響かも\nしれない
entries.en: ...It may be the\neffect of the\nPhoenix Dance.

entries.jp: どういうことぜよ？
entries.en: What d'ya mean?

entries.jp: 古い書物にありました\n鳳舞を見た大人は\n囚須状態になるけれど
entries.en:
I read it in an old
book. Adults who
see the Phoenix
Dance fall into a
trance, but...

entries.jp: 感受性の強い人や\n子供は倒れて\nしまうこともあるって
entries.en:
...sensitive people
and children can
sometimes
collapse.

entries.jp: きっと　鳳舞の影響が\n残っていてさっきの天歌が\n引き金になったのですね
entries.en:
The Phoenix
Dance's effect
must have
lingered, and
Heaven's Song
just now
triggered it.

entries.jp: シンディは子供並み\n……っちゅうことか
entries.en:
So Shindy's on par
with a kid... is
what you're
sayin'?

entries.jp: 元気ならからかって\nやりたいとこじゃが\n……そうもいかんな
entries.en:
If he was well, I'd
tease him
somethin' fierce...
but I can't now.

entries.jp: 龍馬くん……\n晋作を連れて　一刻も早く\nここを離れましょう
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun... Let's
take Shinsaku and
leave this place as
soon as possible.

entries.jp: 新選組の新しい鳳舞\nそして天歌だけでも\nこの状態なんですよ？
entries.en:
Just the
Shinsengumi's
new Phoenix
Dance and
Heaven's Song did
all this, you
know?

entries.jp: 鳳舞合奏ともなれば\nどれだけの事になるか
entries.en:
With Phoenix
Rising, who
knows how bad it
will get.

entries.jp: それは　無意味じゃ\n天歌は　広まっとる
entries.en: That's pointless.\nHeaven's Song is\nspreadin'.

entries.jp: どこへ逃げても\nいずれは耳に入る
entries.en:
No matter where
we run, sooner or
later it'll reach
our ears.

entries.jp: では　どうすればいい？\nこのままでは　晋作は……
entries.en:
Then what should
we do? At this
rate, Shinsaku
will...

entries.jp: 大好きなロックを\n愛するロックを　まともに\n歌えなくなってしまう
entries.en:
...never be able to
properly sing the
rock he loves, the
rock he adores.

entries.jp: 止めさせりゃええ\nまだ　実験なんじゃろ？
entries.en:
We make 'em stop.
It's still just an
experiment,
right?

entries.jp: ここで失敗すりゃあ\n井伊も天歌泰平を\n広めようとはせんじゃろ
entries.en:
If it flops here, I
reckon Ii won't try
to spread his
Heaven's Song
Peace.

entries.jp: 簡単に言ってくれますね\nどうやって　やる気です？
entries.en:
You make it
sound easy. How
do you intend to
do it?

entries.jp: そんなもんは知らん
entries.en: Beats me.

entries.jp: わしは　頭が働かん\nこういうのは\nセンセーの仕事じゃろ？
entries.en:
My brain don't
work that way.
That kinda thing's
Sensei's job, ain't
it?

entries.jp: そう……ですね\nええ　これは私の\nやるべきこと……
entries.en: Yes... I suppose\nso. Yes, this is\nwhat I must do...

entries.jp: そろそろ\n準備はええか？
entries.en: You about ready?

entries.jp: 一人足りない分\nちょっと心細いですが……
entries.en:
We're one
member short, so
I'm a little
uneasy, but...

entries.jp: この新しく発明した\n音響装置　蓄音機で\nカバーします
entries.en:
...I'll cover for it
with this newly
invented sound
device: a
phonograph.

entries.jp: おお……\nこら摩訶不思議じゃ\nベースが流れてきた
entries.en:
Whoa... Now that's
a real marvel!
There's bass
comin' out!

entries.jp: いざという時のことを\n考えて　この間の演奏を\n録音していました
entries.en:
With an
emergency in
mind, I recorded
our last
performance.

entries.jp: それを再生する機械を\n急いで作ったんです
entries.en: Then I hurried to\nbuild a machine\nto play it back.

entries.jp: どの程度　効果があるか\n保証はできませんが
entries.en: I can't guarantee\nhow effective it'll\nbe, though.

entries.jp: その分は　わしらの\n心意気と魂で\nなんとかするぜよ
entries.en:
We'll make up the
difference with
our spirit and
soul, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 遠く　夕暮れの彦根に\n天歌が響き渡る
entries.en:
Heaven's Song
rang out far
across Hikone at
dusk.

entries.jp:
思い思いの方向を
向いていた人々が
音の流れてくる
方向を向いて
ゆっくりと歩き出した
entries.en:
People who had
been facing every
which way turned
toward the source
of the sound and
slowly began to
walk.

entries.jp:
皆の顔に浮かぶのは
恍惚の笑み
判で押したように
一様に同じ表情をしている
entries.en:
On every face
was a rapt smile,
each one exactly
the same, as if
stamped out.

entries.jp: おお　来た来た\nそんじゃいくぜよ
entries.en: Ooh, here they\ncome! Let's do\nthis!

entries.jp: 烈ロックンロール
entries.en: Let's rock 'n' roll!

entries.jp: 龍馬と桂の演奏に\n人の波がピクリと止まる
entries.en:
At Ryoma and
Katsura's playing,
the wave of
people froze with
a twitch.

entries.jp: あるものは耳を押さえ\nあるものは胸を掻きむしり\n苦しげに呻く
entries.en:
Some covered
their ears, some
clawed at their
chests, groaning
in pain.

entries.jp: な　なんじゃ……\nなんか　妙じゃぞ
entries.en: Wh-what the...\nSomethin's off\nhere!

entries.jp: 演奏を止めないで！\n洗脳が強ければ強いほど\n反発は強いんだ
entries.en:
Don't stop
playing! The
stronger the
brainwashing, the
stronger the
backlash!

entries.jp: もっと　強く\nもっと過激に……\nもっと……
entries.en: Harder... More\nextreme... More...

entries.jp: しかし　演奏が\nエスカレートすればする\nほど民達は苦しげに呻く
entries.en:
But the more the
music escalated,
the more the
people groaned in
agony.

entries.jp: ……くっ　どうして
entries.en: ...Ngh, why?

entries.jp: そんなの\n決まってんだろ？
entries.en: Isn't it obvious?

entries.jp: 一人足りないからだっ
entries.en: Because you're\none man short!

entries.jp: 晋作……
entries.en: Shinsaku...

entries.jp: シンディ\n来てくれたんか
entries.en: Shindy! You came!

entries.jp: 置いてきぼりにするな
entries.en: Don't leave me\nbehind

entries.jp: 淋しかったわけじゃない
entries.en: Not that I was\nlonely

entries.jp: お前達だけじゃ心許ない
entries.en: You two can't be\ntrusted alone

entries.jp: 置いてきぼりにするな！\nオレ様抜きでどうする\nつもりだったんだよ
entries.en:
Don't leave me
behind! What
were you
planning to do
without yours
truly?

entries.jp: いや　シンディの体を\n心配して置いてきたんじゃ
entries.en:
Well, we left ya
behind 'cause we
were worried
about your
health, Shindy.

entries.jp: そうそう　出るときも\nまだ寝ていて　具合が\n悪そうでしたし
entries.en:
That's right. You
were still asleep
when we left, and
you looked
unwell.

entries.jp: ……疑ってすまん
entries.en: ...Sorry I doubted\nyou.

entries.jp: ……べ　別に\n一人で淋しかったとか
entries.en: ...I-it's not like I\nwas lonely by\nmyself...

entries.jp: そんなことは\n無いんだからな！
entries.en: ...or anything like\nthat, got it!?

entries.jp: 素直じゃないのう
entries.en: Can't ever say\nwhat you mean,\ncan ya?

entries.jp: でも　そこが\n晋作の可愛いところですよ
entries.en: But that's what's\ncute about\nShinsaku.

entries.jp: お前達だけじゃ\n心許ないからな
entries.en: You two can't be\ntrusted alone,\nthat's all.

entries.jp: 体はもういいのですか？
entries.en: Is your body all\nright now?

entries.jp: ふん\nちょっと目眩がしただけだ\n心配はいらねえ
entries.en: Hmph. I just got a\nlittle dizzy. No\nneed to worry.

entries.jp: クールに激しくかまずぜ！\n雷ロックンロール
entries.en: Let's go cool and\nfierce! Thunder\nrock 'n' roll!

entries.jp: 高杉も加わり\n音楽は激しさを増す
entries.en:
With Takasugi
joining in, the
music grew
fiercer.

entries.jp:
飛び交う音階
激しいメロディ
苦痛しか見せなかった
人々が少しずつ
変化していく
entries.en:
Notes flew and
melodies raged,
and the people
who had shown
nothing but pain
began, little by
little, to change.

entries.jp: やがて\nうつろだった顔に\n表情が戻ってきた
entries.en:
At last,
expression
returned to their
empty faces.

entries.jp: ……な　なんだここ？\nオレは何をしていたんだ
entries.en: ...Wh-where am I?\nWhat was I\ndoing?

entries.jp: あやや？\n畑を耕しとった\nはずなんだが
entries.en: Huh? I coulda\nsworn I was\nplowin' my field.

entries.jp: やったな　シンディ
entries.en: Ya did it, Shindy!

entries.jp: まあな
entries.en: Yeah, well.

entries.jp: どうした\nセンセー
entries.en: What's wrong,\nSensei?

entries.jp: あ　いや……晋作は\nやはりすごいですね
entries.en: Oh, nothing...\nShinsaku really is\namazing.

entries.jp: 当たり前だぜ！
entries.en: Of course I am!

entries.jp: よし！\nこのまま雷舞をやってる\n寺に乗り込むぜよ
entries.en:
All right! Let's
storm the temple
where they're
holdin' the live!

entries.jp:
雷舞の行われている
寺へ駆け込むと
そこには
見知った顔が居た
entries.en:
When they
rushed into the
temple where the
live was being
held, there stood
a familiar face.

entries.jp: ソ　ソウちん\nな　なんでいる？
entries.en: S-So-chin!\nWh-what're you\ndoin' here?

entries.jp: 今日は随分とお客さんが\n少ないと思ってたら
entries.en:
I was wondering
why there were
so few guests
today...

entries.jp: トサカくんの\n仕業だったんだ
entries.en: ...so it was your\ndoing,\nTosaka-kun.

entries.jp: 我々の演奏でもすぐには\n解くことが出来なかった\n洗脳……
entries.en:
Brainwashing
that even our
playing couldn't
break right
away...

entries.jp: 最初に鳳舞で囚須状態に\nして天歌を繰り返し聴かせ\n洗脳する……
entries.en:
First the Phoenix
Dance puts them
in a trance, then
Heaven's Song is
played to them
over and over
until they're
brainwashed...

entries.jp: やはり\nこれが鳳舞合奏の\n正体ですね
entries.en: So this is the true\nnature of Phoenix\nRising.

entries.jp: よく知ってるね\nメガネくん
entries.en: You know a lot,\nGlasses-kun.

entries.jp: ……そういうことに\n多少は知識がありますから
entries.en: ...I know a little\nabout such things.

entries.jp: だったら　わかってるよね\n邪魔しちゃダメだって
entries.en: Then you know\nyou mustn't get in\nthe way, right?

entries.jp: うっ……\nな　なんだ　この音楽
entries.en: Ugh... Wh-what is\nthis music...

entries.jp: この間と……全然違う
entries.en: It's... nothing like\nlast time.

entries.jp: あの時は　ちゃんと準備が\n出来ていなかったからね\nでも　ここは違う
entries.en:
Last time, we
weren't properly
prepared. But this
place is different.

entries.jp: ここは鳳舞合奏のために\n廃寺を改造して\n作られた寺なんだよ？
entries.en:
This temple was
remodeled from
an abandoned
one, just for
Phoenix Rising,
you know?

entries.jp: 沖田が両手をあげると\n民達から歓声が上がる
entries.en:
When Okita
raised both
hands, cheers
rose from the
people.

entries.jp:
今から始まる鳳舞合奏は
踊りと天歌の融合した
いわば究極の剣舞
（ショー）
entries.en:
Up next, Phoenix
Rising fuses
dance and
Heaven's Song:
the ultimate
sword-dance
show, you might
say.

entries.jp: く　くぅ……\nそんなもの\n打ち砕いてくれる
entries.en: Ngh... Ngh... I'll\nsmash it to pieces!

entries.jp: 沖田に対抗するように\nベースをかき鳴らす高杉
entries.en:
Takasugi
thrashed his bass
as if to challenge
Okita.

entries.jp:
しかし
大きいだけの
その音は民衆には
見向きもされない
entries.en:
But the sound
was merely loud,
and the people
didn't so much as
glance his way.

entries.jp: く　くぅ……\n頭がぐらぐらする\n指が……震える
entries.en:
Ngh... Nnngh... My
head's spinning...
My fingers... are
shaking...

entries.jp: 晋作
entries.en: Shinsaku!

entries.jp:
ピックを取り落とし
崩れ落ちる高杉を
沖田は冷めた目で
見下ろす
entries.en:
Takasugi dropped
his pick and
collapsed. Okita
looked down at
him with cold
eyes.

entries.jp: 威勢のいいことを\n言ってたから　どんだけ\n強いのかと思ったら
entries.en:
You talked so big,
I was wondering
just how strong
you'd be...

entries.jp: ……な～んか　肩すかし\nろくに立ち上がれも\nしないじゃない
entries.en:
...but what a
letdown. You can
barely even stand
up.

entries.jp: く　くそ……
entries.en: D-dammit...

entries.jp: キミはやっぱり\nスカシくんだね
entries.en: You really are Mr.\nPoser, aren't you?

entries.jp: すかした顔してるし\n肩すかしだし\nスカシくんだ～♪
entries.en:
You act all cool,
and you're all
pose and no
punch, so you're
Mr. Poser~

entries.jp: 新選組一番隊組長\n沖田総司　抜刀……\n理由は……後でいいや
entries.en:
Captain of the
Shinsengumi's
First Unit, Soji
Okita, drawing
his sword... The
reason? ...I'll think
of one later.

entries.jp: なっ……何もせんと\n言ってたじゃろ
entries.en:
Wh-whoa... You
said you weren't
gonna do
anything!

entries.jp: ああ\nトサカくんにはね～
entries.en: Yeah, not to you,\nTosaka-kun~

entries.jp: でもね　調子に乗って\n飛んでる虫は\nたたき落としておかないと
entries.en:
But you know,
when a bug gets
cocky and starts
buzzing around,
you have to swat
it down.

entries.jp: 実験の邪魔しちゃだめだよ\n失敗したら　新選組の\nせいになっちゃうかも
entries.en:
You can't mess up
the experiment. If
it fails, the
Shinsengumi
might get the
blame.

entries.jp: 近藤さんの新選組の経歴には\n虫さされ一つ\n許されないんだから
entries.en:
Kondo-san's
Shinsengumi can't
have so much as a
single bug bite on
its record.

entries.jp: 沖田は高杉に近付き\nゆっくりと刀を抜く
entries.en:
Okita approached
Takasugi and
slowly drew his
sword.

entries.jp: そして　キミはこのまま\nな～んにもしないで\n僕に殺されるんだ
entries.en:
And now you're
going to do
nothing at all,
and let me kill
you.

entries.jp: これが本当の\nスカ死　な～んちゃって\nあはははは
entries.en:
From Poser to
decomposer! Get
it? Just kidding~
Ahahahaha!

entries.jp: させるか
entries.en: Not on my watch!

entries.jp: 痛っ\nトサカくん　ちょっと\n邪魔しないでよ
entries.en:
Ow! Tosaka-kun,
come on, quit
getting in the
way.

entries.jp: 仲間が殺されかけとるのに\n助けに入らんバカはおらん
entries.en:
My pal's about to
get killed! There
ain't a fool alive
who wouldn't
jump in to help!

entries.jp: どっちかって言うと\n助けに入るバカじゃない？
entries.en:
If anything, isn't
it the one who
jumps in who's
the fool?

entries.jp: もう　おひねりで羊羹\n貰ったのなんて\n初めてだよ……
entries.en:
Jeez. That's the
first time
anyone's ever
tossed me yokan
as a tip...

entries.jp: 沖田は片手を刀から\n離すとゆっくりと\n横に伸ばした
entries.en:
Okita took one
hand off his
sword and slowly
stretched it out to
the side.

entries.jp:
……でもトサカくんから
初めての貢ぎ物なんだし
御礼（サービス）
しなくちゃね
entries.en:
...But it's the very
first gift I've
gotten from you,
Tosaka-kun. I'll
have to give you
some fan service
in return.

entries.jp: 鳳舞合奏　交響曲第一章　\n\fnt1煌燐雅劇\fnt0\n（フライングシンフォニア）
entries.en:
Phoenix Rising,
Symphony
Movement One:
 nt1Flying Symphonia nt0

entries.jp: なっ……

隊士達は沖田の後ろに
重なりポジションを
変えながら龍馬に向けて
斬撃を繰り出す
entries.en:
The troopers
lined up behind
Okita, shifting
positions as they
unleashed slash
after slash at
Ryoma.

entries.jp:
沖田が避けると
後ろから隊士達の剣が
沖田が剣撃を繰り出すと
それに重なるように
何十もの刃が飛び出す
entries.en:
When Okita
dodged, the
troopers' swords
came from behind
him. When he
struck, dozens of
blades leapt out
along with his.

entries.jp: ほらほら　ちゃんと\n避けてよ　トサカくん\n手が滑って殺しちゃうよ？
entries.en:
Come on, come
on, dodge
properly,
Tosaka-kun. Or
my hand might
slip and kill you.

entries.jp: くっ……
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.jp:
防戦一方の龍馬
最初はなんとか
避けていたものの
少しずつ剣先が
着物の袖をかすめ始めた
entries.en:
Ryoma could only
defend. At first
he managed to
dodge, but bit by
bit the sword tips
began grazing his
kimono sleeves.

entries.jp: なんじゃ　これは……\n体が……思うように……\n動かなくなってきたぜよ
entries.en:
What in the... My
body... ain't movin'
like it oughta, I
tell ya.

entries.jp: 今さら気づいた？\nこの音楽　剣舞　そして\nこの刀の煌めきさえ
entries.en:
Only noticing
now? This music,
the sword dance,
even the gleam of
this blade...

entries.jp: 鳳舞合奏の一部なんだ\n魅せるための技でしか\nないんだよ
entries.en:
...it's all part of
Phoenix Rising.
They're nothing
but techniques to
captivate.

entries.jp: な　なに……
entries.en: Wh-what...

entries.jp: ほら　身体が重いよね？\nもう目も開かなくなって\n戦う意思も失せてくる
entries.en:
See? Your body
feels heavy,
right? Soon you
can't keep your
eyes open, and
your will to fight
just fades away.

entries.jp: うっ……\nか　体が……
entries.en: Ugh... M-my\nbody...

entries.jp: 羊羹ありがとうトサカくん\n最初に邪魔したの　そっち\nだし　悪く思わないでね
entries.en:
Thanks for the
yokan,
Tosaka-kun. You
got in the way
first, so no hard
feelings, okay?

entries.jp: まず最初にさようなら……\nトサカくん　　\n目障りなんだよっ！
entries.en:
First up,
goodbye...
Tosaka-kun.
You're an eyesore!

entries.jp: か　体が動かん\nもう　避けられん……っ
entries.en: C-can't move a\nmuscle... Ain't no\ndodgin' this one...!

entries.jp: そこまでです！\n新選組　沖田総司
entries.en: That's enough!\nSoji Okita of the\nShinsengumi!

entries.jp: ああ　アンタもいたね\nスカシくんと一緒に\n倒れたんじゃないの？
entries.en:
Oh, you were
here too. Didn't
you go down
along with Mr.
Poser?

entries.jp: ……ふふっ
entries.en: ...Heh.

entries.jp: ……どうして\n鳳舞合奏の影響を\n受けていないのかな？
entries.en:
...Why am I
unaffected by
Phoenix Rising, I
wonder?

entries.jp: これです\n火縄銃用の耳栓
entries.en: This. Earplugs,\nfor matchlock\nguns.

entries.jp: 桂は軽く頭を振ると\n小さな固まりを二つ\n取り出した
entries.en:
Katsura gave his
head a light
shake and took
out two small
lumps.

entries.jp: 倒れたフリして\nそれつけてたのか……\nああ……成る程
entries.en:
You put those in
while you were
pretending to be
down... Ah... I see.

entries.jp: 随分と用意がいいね\nメガネくん
entries.en: You sure came\nwell prepared,\nGlasses-kun.

entries.jp: 私はとても神経質で\n旅先で　枕が変わっても\n眠れないくらいなんです
entries.en:
I'm a very
sensitive person.
When I travel, I
can't sleep if my
pillow is
different.

entries.jp: なのに　この二人ときたら\nいびきがうるさくて……\nこういう物が必要なんです
entries.en:
And yet these two
snore so terribly...
I need things like
this.

entries.jp: よっぽど\nうるさいんだね
entries.en: They must be\nreally loud, huh.

entries.jp: 天歌ほどでは\nありませんよ
entries.en: Not as loud as\nHeaven's Song.

entries.jp: 鳳舞合奏……まさか\nここまで　完成されて\nいたなんて驚きです
entries.en:
Phoenix Rising...
I'm astonished
that it's already
this complete.

entries.jp: 僕が完成させたんだよ\nだって　天才だもの
entries.en: I'm the one who\ncompleted it. I'm a\ngenius, after all.

entries.jp: さあ　刀を下ろして下さい\nそうしないと　次は\nその自慢の顔を狙います
entries.en:
Now, lower your
sword, please. If
you don't, next I'll
aim for that face
you're so proud
of.

entries.jp: いいのかな？\n敵は僕たち新選組だけじゃ\nないんだよ？
entries.en:
Are you sure
about that? We
Shinsengumi
aren't your only
enemies, you
know?

entries.jp: ね　みんな～
entries.en: Right, everyone~?

entries.jp: 沖田が薄く笑うと\nそれに合わせたように\n民衆が動き出す
entries.en:
As Okita smiled
thinly, the crowd
began to move as
if in time with it.

entries.jp: なっ……\nこれは……
entries.en: Wha...! This is...

entries.jp: ここにいるゴミ……\nううん　アリたちだっけ？\nすでに鳳舞合奏の虜なんだ
entries.en:
The trash here...
no, wait, they
were ants, right?
They're already in
thrall to Phoenix
Rising.

entries.jp: 僕の言葉で好きに動くんだ\nさあ　その男と楽しく\n遊んであげてよ
entries.en:
They move
however I tell
them to. Now, go
have some fun
playing with that
man.

entries.jp: 遊ぶ　遊ぶ……\n幕府に　井伊様に逆らう\n潰す……消す……遊ぶ
entries.en:
Play... play...
Those who defy
the shogunate...
who defy
Ii-sama... Crush
'em... erase 'em...
Play...

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\n動けますか？
entries.en: Ryoma-kun, can\nyou move?

entries.jp: ああ\nなんとか……
entries.en: Yeah... More or\nless...

entries.jp: なら　晋作を背負って\n逃げて下さい\n私が時間を稼ぎます
entries.en:
Then carry
Shinsaku on your
back and run. I'll
buy you time.

entries.jp: なんじゃと
entries.en: What!?

entries.jp: そんなこと……\nで　出来るか
entries.en: Like I... c-could\never do that...

entries.jp: シンディ……ッ\n大丈夫なのか
entries.en: Shindy...! You\nokay?

entries.jp: 大丈夫だ\n頭はくらくらするが\nお前よりしっかりしてる
entries.en:
I'm fine. My
head's spinning,
but I'm steadier
than you.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんと晋作は\nこんなところで\n負けちゃいけない
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun and
Shinsaku mustn't
lose in a place
like this.

entries.jp: 私と違って\n貴方たちは才能がある\n生き延びて下さい
entries.en: Unlike me, you\ntwo have talent.\nPlease, survive.

entries.jp: 生き延びるって\nセンセー死ぬ気じゃ\nイカンぜよ！
entries.en:
Survive? Sensei,
don't you go
plannin' to die on
us!

entries.jp: 死ぬ気は\nないですけどね
entries.en: I don't plan to\ndie, though.

entries.jp: バカじゃない？\nこの状況で生き残れるはず\nないでしょう
entries.en: Are you stupid?\nThere's no way\nyou'll survive this.

entries.jp: 仲間のために犠牲になる\nだなんて　メガネくん\nってば　偽善者だねぇ
entries.en:
Sacrificing
yourself for your
friends... What a
hypocrite you are,
Glasses-kun.

entries.jp: でも　無駄にしてあげるよ\nあんたなんか瞬殺だもの
entries.en:
But I'll make it all
for nothing. I can
kill you in an
instant.

entries.jp: そうでしょうか\n私はしつこいですよ\n粘ってみせます！
entries.en:
Is that so? I'm
very persistent,
you know. I'll hold
out, just watch!

entries.jp: さあ　早く逃げるんです\n龍馬くん！\n晋作を頼みますよ
entries.en:
Now, hurry and
run, Ryoma-kun!
I'm counting on
you to look after
Shinsaku!

entries.jp: センセーーーーッ
entries.en: SENSEEEEEI!

entries.jp: だ……ダメだっ\n桂さん！
entries.en: N-no...!\nKatsura-san!

entries.jp: 私が守ってみせる！\n龍馬くんを　晋作を！\n洗脳された民たちを
entries.en:
I'll protect them!
Ryoma-kun,
Shinsaku! And the
brainwashed
people!

entries.jp: 松陰先生\n見ていてください
entries.en: Shoin-sensei,\nplease watch over\nme.

entries.jp: この桂小五郎\n一世一代のロックを\n演じてみせます
entries.en:
I, Kogoro
Katsura, will
perform the rock
of a lifetime!

entries.jp: 松陰先生が教えてくれた\nロック魂　いまこそ！
entries.en:
The rock soul
Shoin-sensei
taught me... now
is its time!

entries.jp: 先生……\n私に勇気と力を下さい\n二人の未来を守れる力を！
entries.en:
Sensei... give me
courage and
strength. The
strength to
protect the future
of you two!

entries.jp: センセー\n……その光は
entries.en: Sensei... That\nlight...

entries.jp: ……これ\n龍馬くんや\n晋作と同じ……
entries.en:
...This is... the
same as
Ryoma-kun's and
Shinsaku's...

entries.jp: 超魂の欠片……\n片魂の光じゃ
entries.en:
A shard of the
Ultra Soul... It's
the light of a
Piece Soul!

entries.jp: センセーのわしらを\n想う気持ちが\n民を想う気持ちが
entries.en:
Your feelin's for
us, Sensei... your
feelin's for the
people...

entries.jp: 奇跡を起こしたんじゃ
entries.en: ...they went and\nworked a miracle!

entries.jp: ……これがあれば\n皆を救えるかもしれない
entries.en: ...With this, I\nmight be able to\nsave everyone.

entries.jp: 前言撤回です\n二人とも私に力を貸して\n下さい
entries.en:
I take back what I
said. Both of you,
please lend me
your strength.

entries.jp: 私のロック魂で\n邪悪な企みを\n打ち砕きます
entries.en:
With my rock
soul, I'll shatter
their wicked
scheme!

entries.jp: おうっ！
entries.en: Yeah!

entries.jp: 私の声は小さくて\nまだまだ　この国の皆には\n届けられない
entries.en:
My voice is small,
and it still can't
reach everyone in
this country.

entries.jp: 魂に　熱情に軽重などない\n私は望むよ　自由な世界\n人々が楽しく笑い合える
entries.en:
Soul and passion
have no weight,
light or heavy. I
wish for a free
world, where
people laugh
happily together.

entries.jp: 『重力のない世界』
entries.en: 'A World Without\nGravity'
